insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured + Booster+ Sum Insured + Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured (as per plan/Policy Schedule)

great.name: Room rent: No limit / any room (default wording)
great.quote: “We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: Default wording indicates no room rent capping (you can choose any room). This helps avoid proportionate deductions due to room category limits.

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer: ReAssure “Forever” (unlimited reinstatement-like cover after first paid claim)
great.quote: “ReAssure “Forever”: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure “Forever”. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.”
great.explanation: This is an additional SI buffer that can fund future claims after the base is exhausted (triggered after the first paid claim), giving very strong long-term protection.

great.name: Consumables / non-payable items covered (Safeguard / Safeguard+ - Claim Safeguard)
great.quote: “Claim Safeguard: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I – Expenses not covered’ of Annexure I’.”
great.explanation: Consumables/non-payables (e.g., gloves, masks, kits etc. listed in Annexure I) are typically out-of-pocket. Here they are covered if you choose Safeguard/Safeguard+.

great.name: Post-hospitalization coverage: 180 days
great.explanation: 180 days post-hospitalization is at the upper end of standard coverage and reduces follow-up expense burden.

great.name: Domiciliary / Home care treatment covered
great.quote: “Home Care Treatment means treatment availed by the insured person at home which in normal course would require care and treatment at a hospital but is actually taken at home...”
great.explanation: Covers eligible treatment taken at home when hospital-like care is required (subject to the stated conditions).

good.name: PED waiting period: 36 months
good.quote: “...excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.”
good.explanation: 36 months PED waiting is common/acceptable in the market (not a red flag).

good.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: “...excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...”
good.explanation: 24 months for listed diseases/procedures is standard.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (illness)
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded...”
good.explanation: 30-day initial waiting for illnesses is standard; accidents are typically covered from day 1.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization coverage: 60 days
good.quote: “...for 60 days before the date of admission...”

good.name: Air ambulance covered (with limit)
good.quote: “Air Ambulance: Only in case of Emergency. Maximum INR 2,50,000 per hospitalization.”
good.explanation: Air ambulance is a valuable add-on-type benefit; limit applies per hospitalization.

good.name: Modern treatments covered (listed procedures)
good.quote: “We pay for Modern treatments as specified below: 1. Uterine Artery Embolization and HIFU... 7. Robotic surgeries ...”
good.explanation: Modern treatments are covered as per the specified list (coverage is positive, but list-based).

good.name: Optional room type modification available (flexibility)
good.quote: “Room Type Modification... You can choose between a Single Private Room and a Sharing Room.”
good.explanation: Flexibility to select room category for pricing/lifestyle. (Default wording still says no room limit; this is an option mentioned in the product.)

bad.name: Restore benefit: Not found (assumed not covered)
bad.explanation: No restore/reinstatement clause explicitly stating replenishment of Sum Insured after a claim was found in the provided wording. If absent, Sum Insured is NOT replenished after a claim (separate from the ReAssure “Forever” buffer, which activates after first paid claim).

bad.name: NCB / Renewal Bonus: Not found (assumed not covered)
bad.explanation: No explicit No Claim Bonus / cumulative bonus increase schedule on renewal was found. If absent, Sum Insured does not grow at renewal via NCB. (Booster+ is a different mechanism; it’s not presented as an NCB in the provided text.)

bad.name: Cashless network size: Not stated (treated as not meeting minimum disclosure; assume not covered for thresholding)
bad.quote: “Cashless claim facility is available at our network hospitals ONLY... for the latest list, refer to our website www.nivabupa.com.”
bad.explanation: Number of network hospitals is not provided in the wording excerpt, so it cannot be confirmed whether it meets >7,000 / >10,000 thresholds. This is a practical gap for comparing network strength.

unclear.name: Co-payment (percentage/when applicable) not specified
unclear.quote: “Co-Payment: It is the percentage of admissible claim amount You would have to bear, Rest we will pay.”
unclear.explanation: Co-pay is defined but the actual co-pay % and whether it applies by default (or only if chosen via an option/plan) is not stated in the excerpt—verify in Policy Schedule.

unclear.name: Deductible (Annual Aggregate Deductible amount) not specified
unclear.quote: “This is an aggregate amount in a year... which we will NOT pay. Once the total expense exceeds this amount, balance we will pay.”
unclear.explanation: Deductible feature is described but the rupee amount is not provided here; it likely depends on the plan/Policy Schedule.

unclear.reference: Section 3 (Sum Insured sequence) and Section 4.17 Note
